name: ZCA_ORCH_RT_STEP_TRANS
description: Contains the list of intra step transitions in a given Orchestration stage and their run time status in the transactional object's context.

columns.name: STEP_TRANSITION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration step transition object.

columns.name: STEP_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the step to which the step transitions correspond to.

columns.name: STEP_TRANSITION_NUMBER
columns.description: Public unique identifier or alternate key of the Orchestration step transition object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_STAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration stages object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_STEP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration steps object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_STEP_TASKS_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration step tasks object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestrations object.

columns.name: TRANSITION_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the Orchestration step transition. Possible values are NOTSTARTED, INPROGRESS, WAITING, SKIPPED, COMPLETED,etc.

columns.name: TRANSITION_START_DATE
columns.description: Date and timestamp when the step transition started.

columns.name: TRANSITION_END_DATE
columns.description: Date and timestamp when the step transition ended.

columns.name: TRANSITION_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Date and timestamp when the step transition is due.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the activity id.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_ASSOC_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration association.

columns.name: INBOUND_CONV_MSG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the inbound conversation messsage id.

columns.name: OUTBOUND_CONV_MSG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the outbound conversation messsage id.

columns.name: INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the interaction id.

columns.name: CONVERSATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the conversation id.

columns.name: WRAP_UP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the wrap up id.

columns.name: EMAIL_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the email to which the step transition is associated with.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Specifies the brief comments needed for runtime step transition row.

columns.name: SUCCESSCRITERIA_EVAL_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies the step's success criteria evaluation result.

columns.name: REFRESH_PAGE_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether or not to refresh the whole page before surfacing the current Step in the runtime UI.

columns.name: CURRENT_STEP_TRANS_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether it is the current INPROGRESS Step transition or the most recently updated step transition row.

columns.name: GENAI_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Y/N flag to indicate whether the row is created by Gen AI or not.

columns.name: GENAI_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Y/N flag to indicate whether the row is updated by Gen AI or not.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).
